key_policy: Proposal: add the existing controller FullAccess public key to the new contract; operator retains that key locally. No private key read, generated, exported or shared in preparation. This intentionally shares custody across controller and new contract; compromise affects both and permits upgrades. Owner may instead supply a dedicated public key and authorized local custody workflow. No key deletion is authorized.

funding_allocations.note: All financial and storage deposits, auth yoctoNEAR and actor gas reservations come from these actor allocations; do not add them again.

pricing.gas_note: 110 Tgas function envelope plus 10 Tgas scheduling/action-fee allowance; each actor also receives 0.1 NEAR buffer, rounded upward to 0.01 NEAR.

post_stop_exit.precondition: Use actual finalized storage_balance_of.total, expected 0.019 NEAR; no live tokens/refs/records/pending refund. Stop at transaction 38 verified stopped=true.
postconditions: FINAL root/transfer/callback success on independent RPCs
Borrower storage_balance_of=null and user record removed after refund callback
Exact funded native refund and accounting reconciliation
No repeat unregister to claim twice

browser_acceptance.policy: Use the isolated staging browser wallet for this existing approved plan transaction; CLI must not also issue. Continue only after exact signer/receiver/action and FINAL receipts verified. Browser owner interaction required; CLI signing cannot count as browser acceptance.

confirmation_required: Confirm all six IDs and present control of controller/holder/borrower/nft_holder/lender; confirm those accounts can sign through authorized local/wallet workflow
Approve proposed contract public key/custody or supply a dedicated PUBLIC key only
Approve exact artifact, initialization, immutable caps and transaction graph digest
Approve allocations and maximum 13.24 testnet NEAR ceiling; no mainnet spending
Approve legitimate faucet request(s) to confirmed controller, respecting rate limits; if insufficient stop rather than creating faucet-bypass accounts
Authorize subsequent atomic fresh account creation/deployment and bounded sequential signing only after sufficient finalized funding

owner_confirmation.answer: Confirm all, authorize bounded testnet execution and faucet requests
owner_confirmation.scope: Exact accounts, public keys/shared operator custody, artifact, initialization, immutable caps, 39-transaction graph, allocations and 13.24 testnet NEAR ceiling confirmed in chat; no mainnet authority
